title: GPU-change gate: validation-layer diff and GPU list for integrated PRs
objective: CONTRIBUTING.md requires GPU changes (AGC, shader recompiler, VideoOut) to have validation-layer runs on main and on the change with no new VUID- errors, plus the vendor/model/driver/OS of each GPU tested.
description: CONTRIBUTING.md requires GPU changes (AGC, shader recompiler, VideoOut) to have validation-layer runs on main and on the change with no new VUID- errors, plus the vendor/model/driver/OS of each GPU tested. Only 645 of 2559 parsed open PR bodies have a non-n/a 'GPUs tested' line. Wire tools/vulkan_validation_gate.py into the ORBIS integration pipeline so no agc/shader PR is integrated without that evidence.
acceptance: The gate runs on lavapipe in the ORB-002 container on main and on a candidate PR and reports new VUIDs
ORBIS refuses to integrate a PR labelled agc or shader without a GPUs-tested record (upstream's or ORBIS's own)
Documented how the gate differs from upstream usage, if it does
